articles.headline: EU begins enforcing AI Act rules for general-purpose AI models
articles.summary: The European Commission’s AI Act enforcement powers for general-purpose AI models took effect on 2 August 2026, with penalties that can reach 3% of global annual turnover and, in some cases, model withdrawal from the market. This creates immediate compliance and contracting implications for companies using, integrating, or supplying frontier AI systems in Europe.

articles.headline: OpenAI cuts developer prices for GPT-5.6 Sol by more than 20%
articles.summary: OpenAI is lowering prices for its frontier GPT-5.6 Sol model for developers, a move that can reduce AI application costs for companies building or scaling products on top of the model. The pricing cut also signals intensifying competition with Anthropic and Chinese AI vendors, which may pressure enterprise AI margins and vendor strategy.

articles.headline: South Korea plans fund to recycle semiconductor tax windfalls into AI and growth sectors
articles.summary: South Korea plans to create a new fund that redirects semiconductor tax windfalls into support for younger generations and future growth industries such as artificial intelligence. For businesses in chips, AI infrastructure, and supply chains, the move signals continued state backing for strategic technology investment and possible competitive pressure in memory and semiconductor markets.
